NISAR_L_band_24cm.canopy_penetration: Penetrates canopy to sense peat surface moisture

Sentinel1_C_band_5_6cm.canopy_penetration: Scatters mostly in upper leaves/twigs; weaker water-table sensitivity

sentinel1_contrast.scientific_takeaway_en: Both NISAR L-band and Sentinel-1 C-band show backscatter decreases in open drained peat between June and September 2026, but L-band (24 cm) exhibits nearly 3x stronger dynamic range (-2.45 dB vs -0.85 dB) because longer wavelengths penetrate vegetation cover to reach the peat surface.
sentinel1_contrast.scientific_takeaway_id: Baik NISAR L-band maupun Sentinel-1 C-band menunjukkan penurunan hamburan balik pada gambut terdrainase terbuka antara Juni dan September 2026, namun L-band (24 cm) memiliki rentang sinyal hampir 3x lebih kuat (-2,45 dB vs -0,85 dB) karena gelombang panjang menembus tajuk vegetasi hingga mencapai permukaan tanah gambut.
